authors.name: Adam Brown
authors.description:
Adam Brown is an AI specialist at Acme, where he leads research initiatives for the company. With a Ph.D. in Computer Science and a decade of hands-on experience spanning natural-language processing, retrieval-augmented generation, and enterprise chatbot deployments, Adam has helped Fortune 500 clients streamline support operations and unlock new revenue with conversational AI. 

On the Acme blog he’ll translate cutting-edge research into practical playbooks, covering topics such as prompt engineering, vector databases, guardrails, and real-world case studies. When he’s not tinkering with LLM fine-tuning or writing, Adam mentors junior engineers and speaks at AI conferences about ethical AI and scalable deployment patterns.
